description: Defines the enum ChargeTimeType with various charge timing categories for different financial products, including methods for validation and type checks.

classes.name: ChargeTimeType
classes.description: Enumeration of different charge timing types with associated properties and utility methods.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the charge time type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the charge time type.

methods.name: validLoanValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values valid for loan charges.

methods.name: validLoanChargeValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values valid for loan charges.

methods.name: validSavingsValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values valid for savings charges.

methods.name: validClientValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values valid for client charges.

methods.name: validShareValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values valid for share charges.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding ChargeTimeType enum value.

methods.name: isTimeOfDisbursement
methods.description: Checks if the charge time type is disbursement.

methods.name: isOnSpecifiedDueDate
methods.description: Checks if the charge time type is specified due date.
